restatements.text: Allows adults 21 or older to possess up to one ounce of cannabis and removes criminal penalties for doing so.

analysis.answer: Current law makes possession of any amount of cannabis a misdemeanor punishable by up to 90 days in jail. The measure changes this by allowing adults 21 or older to possess up to one ounce of cannabis without it being a criminal offense.
The state and local governments would likely save on the direct costs of arresting, prosecuting, and incarcerating individuals for low-level cannabis possession.
People 21 or older may be more likely to possess cannabis. Law enforcement agencies will have to shift enforcement priorities away from low-level cannabis possession.

The measure addresses the criminalization of low-level cannabis possession. It uses a mechanism of fully legalizing possession of up to one ounce for adults 21 and older to remove the associated criminal penalties.
